name: fgetl
expr: fname = tempname; fid = fopen(fname, 'w'); fprintf(fid, 'hello\n'); fclose(fid); fid = fopen(fname, 'r'); line = fgetl(fid); fclose(fid); delete(fname); r1 = double(strlength(line));
comment: Side-effect smoke test (file I/O round-trip in single snippet via tempname). fgetl reads one line (without newline) -- 'hello' has length 5.
